text:
Rachel: FYI prospect " + "Skyline" + " POC hit a spike of 5xxs during a scheduled replay at ~16:05PT. They replayed user traffic with aggressive client retries. Sales and security are on the thread.

Ibrahim: Which model and status codes? Any sample request IDs?

Rachel: Model: r-instruct-large-v1 (hosted). Codes: 500/502/503. Sample req ids: 91f4b7e, ae3d002. Traffic pattern: bursts ~280-340 rps; some requests had batch_size=32.

Priya: Pulling traces. Preliminary pattern: worker-side resource pressure and restart amplification when client retries pile up. Frontdoor sees gRPC UNAVAILABLE then maps to 502/503. Autoscaler added pods but new pods slow to become Ready due to quant kernel JIT. No OOM flagged.

Ibrahim: We also see a spike of concurrent large-batch requests that blow past per-worker memory budget -> RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on a subset, causing restarts and kernel reloads. Retry loops from the client amplify the load.

Ops-Bot: autoscaler: scale request accepted for skyline-poc-pool at 16:06:12; +5 pods requested.

Priya: Short-term mitigations I recommend: (1) enforce tenant max_batch=8 and max_concurrent=25, (2) set tenant header to suggest clients suppress retries on 5xxs (X-Redwood-Suppress-Retries: 1), (3) enable fallback route to r-instruct-medium-quant if queue_threshold exceeded, (4) provision a 1-GPU warm instance for the demo window if Sales wants stronger safety.

Ibrahim: Agree. Also set per-tenant rate-smoothing so a sudden fan-out is spread over a 2s window. That reduces instant pressure on workers.

Ops-Bot: apply: tenant(skyline).max_batch=8 -> accepted
Ops-Bot: apply: tenant(skyline).max_concurrent=25 -> accepted
Ops-Bot: apply: tenant(skyline).fallback=r-instruct-medium-quant -> accepted
Ops-Bot: apply: tenant(skyline).rate_smooth_window=2s -> accepted

Rachel: Sales asked cost for a 3h warm instance.

Priya: Ballpark prewarm cost: ~$0.60/hr for eval GPU -> ~$1.80 for 3h. We can credit first hour for trials if needed. I'll send a short quote.

Ibrahim: I uploaded diagnostics: https://redwood-internal/diag/2955551111 - contains frontdoor spans, worker logs, heap profiles, autoscale events. NOTE: because some prompts contained PII, security requested the bundle be encrypted with tenant KMS. Access is logged.

security-bot: Confirmed: diag bundle encrypted with tenant KMS. Default audit bundles redact prompt text; unredacted bundles require tenant approval and an access request.

Priya: Client-facing mitigation snippet to reduce amplification:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
X-Redwood-Suppress-Retries: 1
{
  "model": "r-instruct-large-v1",
  "batch_size": 8,
  "max_tokens": 128
}
```
Recommend client retries only on connection errors (not on 5xx) and use 2 attempts with jitter (base=100ms, max=1s).

Rachel: After applying changes queue depth dropped and 5xx rate fell from ~14% -> 1.0% over 10m. Monitoring shows some pods still warming.

Ibrahim: Follow-ups: (A) ops to keep tenant caps for 12h, (B) eng-runtime to investigate a persistent kernel warm cache to avoid JIT latency on restart, (C) update trial playbook with prewarm pricing and retry guidance.

Priya: Drafting the security note for Sales: retention, redaction policy, KMS encryption for the bundle, and how to request extended retention. Will loop legal if needed.

sales-bot: Customer asked for "no 5xx" guarantee for the demo.

security-bot: Official stance: we cannot guarantee zero 5xxs on hosted trials. Offer Dedicated deployment with contractual SLA and reserved warm pools for customers that require guarantees. For demos we provide mitigations and a practice replay.

Rachel: Sales will offer the 3h warm prewarm and schedule a 2-minute practice run at demo start. Ops will revert temporary configs after 12h unless Sales asks to keep them. Thanks all.
